name: Melbourne
credit: Rendered live from the open-data model by tools/city_film.js; nothing in it is stock footage.

lines: The real sun, for the day you watch

titles.head: Flinders Street Station
titles.text: A 310 m front in the 1910 cream, terracotta and green that the 2018–2020 repaint restored.

titles.head: The river shuttle
titles.text: Kingfisher and Pelican run the Yarra wharf to wharf, under Princes Bridge to Crown Landing.

titles.head: The Arts Centre spire
titles.text: 162 m of lattice over the Theatres Building, rebuilt taller in 1996.

titles.head: Walk it
titles.text: Talk to the people who know the city, ride the shuttle down the Yarra, fly past the spire.

titles.line: The model, the sun and the city: open them.
